milestone: Reader route boundary / A-02 / A-04 / A-06
scenario: Malformed or non-numeric article route segments stay behind the auth gate and cannot mount the article loader, while valid numeric routes retain the existing reader path.

repair: Moved positive-safe-integer article route parsing to the shared navigation boundary; complete decimal segments are accepted and malformed segments such as 7abc or 7.9 are rejected without parseInt truncation.
Kept invalid-route presentation inside AuthSessionGate so unauthenticated users see the login boundary and authenticated users retain session chrome.
Mounted FocusedArticleScreen only for a validated numeric ID, so invalid routes cannot issue an article detail request.
Added unit and fixture Playwright contracts for parser rejection, auth gating, and zero article requests.
